logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'CONSUME_START eventId=' ++ vars.eventId ++ ' corrId=' ++ vars.corrId ++ ' queue=' ++ vars.sourceQueue ++ ' transientRetries=' ++ (vars.envelope.transientRetries default 0)]
#[output text/plain --- 'PRIORITY_MISROUTE eventId=' ++ vars.eventId ++ ' HIGH event consumed from standard queue; handled as HIGH corrId=' ++ vars.corrId]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import modules::RiskRules output application/java --- RiskRules::finalize(vars.envelope, vars.profile, vars.riskCfg)
%dw 2.0 import modules::RiskRules output application/java var f = RiskRules::finalize(vars.envelope, vars.profile, vars.riskCfg) --- f.riskBand == "HIGH" or f.decision == "BLOCK"

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'ALERT_ENQUEUE_FAILED eventId=' ++ vars.eventId ++ ' reconciler will recover corrId=' ++ vars.corrId]

#[output text/plain --- 'CONSUME_DONE eventId=' ++ vars.eventId ++ ' score=' ++ vars.final.riskScore ++ ' band=' ++ vars.final.riskBand ++ ' decision=' ++ vars.final.decision ++ ' corrId=' ++ vars.corrId]

db:select.doc:name: Select profile
db:select.db:sql: SELECT customer_id, risk_profile, usual_hour_start, usual_hour_end FROM customer_risk_profile WHERE customer_id = :customerId

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'PROFILE_NOT_FOUND eventId=' ++ vars.eventId ++ ' default profile applied (enrichment incomplete) corrId=' ++ vars.corrId]

set-variable.value: #[{ riskProfile: 'STANDARD', usualHourStart: p('risk.usualHourStart') as Number, usualHourEnd: p('risk.usualHourEnd') as Number }]
#[{ riskProfile: vars.profileRows[0].risk_profile, usualHourStart: vars.profileRows[0].usual_hour_start, usualHourEnd: vars.profileRows[0].usual_hour_end }]

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'TRANSIENT_FAILURE_REQUEUE eventId=' ++ (vars.eventId default 'n/a') ++ ' type=' ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ ' retries=' ++ (vars.envelope.transientRetries default 0) ++ ' corrId=' ++ (vars.corrId default 'n/a')]
#[output text/plain --- 'REQUEUE_FAILED eventId=' ++ (vars.eventId default 'n/a') ++ ' corrId=' ++ (vars.corrId default 'n/a') ++ ' payload=' ++ modules::Masking::sanitize(vars.rawBody)]
#[output text/plain --- 'DEAD_LETTER eventId=' ++ (vars.eventId default 'n/a') ++ ' type=' ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ ' corrId=' ++ (vars.corrId default 'n/a')]

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import modules::Masking output application/json --- { reason: error.errorType.namespace ++ ":" ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ " - " ++ Masking::sanitize(error.description), failedAt: now(), correlationId: vars.corrId default correlationId, eventId: vars.eventId default null, sourceQueue: vars.sourceQueue, transientRetries: vars.envelope.transientRetries default 0, originalPayload: Masking::sanitize(vars.rawBody) }

logger.message: #[output text/plain --- 'DLQ_PUBLISH_FAILED eventId=' ++ (vars.eventId default 'n/a') ++ ' corrId=' ++ (vars.corrId default 'n/a') ++ ' payload=' ++ modules::Masking::sanitize(vars.rawBody)]
